content.short: APY Vision provides aPY.vision to track liquidity pool gains and impermanent loss for DeFi investors and protocols.
content.description: APY Vision provides a clear dashboard to track liquidity pool gains and impermanent loss across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Fantom, Avalanche, and Bitcoin. It surfaces the data you need to know when to enter or exit liquidity pools to maximize returns, helping you make informed decisions about your positions. The interface is easy to understand, and pro features become available by holding the $VISION community token. With notable partnerships, APY Vision offers a comprehensive snapshot of the Web3 investing landscape.
